description: Retire a document by moving it under the knowledge base's archive subdirectory, stamping its metadata block, and re-keying its index chunk so it stays discoverable and readable at the new path. The sanctioned alternative to deletion for archive-managed KBs (e.g. workbench).
embedding_description: Archive, retire, or mark superseded a workbench document (a markdown .md file) instead of deleting it: move the file into the knowledge base's archive folder, stamp it with an Archived date (and Superseded_by when a replacement exists), and keep it findable and readable at its new archived path. Use to declare a document done, obsolete, or replaced by a newer version when delete is not allowed and archive is the policy.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Document moved to the archive subdirectory, metadata stamped, and chunk re-keyed to the new path
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValueError: the knowledge base has no archive subdirectory configured. PermissionError: the path is already archived or is a snapshot sidecar. FileExistsError: a document already exists at the archive destination (never overwritten).
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Confirm the KB supports archiving and the source path is a live document; if a successor exists, pass superseded_by.
